an4.128:1.1: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā cattāro acchariyā abbhutadhammā pātubhavanti
an4.128:1.4: sā tathāgatena anālaye dhamme desiyamāne sussuti sotaṃ odahati aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti
an4.128:1.5: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:2.2: sā tathāgatena mānavinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussuti sotaṃ odahati aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti
an4.128:2.3: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ dutiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:3.2: sā tathāgatena opasamike dhamme desiyamāne sussuti sotaṃ odahati aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti
an4.128:3.3: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ tatiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:4.2: sā tathāgatena avijjāvinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussuti sotaṃ odahati aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti
an4.128:4.3: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:4.4: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ime cattāro acchariyā abbhutadhammā pātubhavantīti.
